title: Experiment replay quality
description: Grades completed offline replay experiment results against the frozen replay judge dimensions so experiment outcomes become trendable scorecards.

criteria.title: Outcome quality
criteria.model: The selected replay continuation achieves the task intent with correct, complete, verifiable work.
criteria.method: Read the experiment result's replay D1 mean for the selected arm and compare it to the baseline context.
criteria.driftMarkers: Selected-arm D1 is low, no selected arm has scored cells, or replay repeatedly selects arms that do not complete the task.

criteria.title: Process quality
criteria.model: The selected replay continuation uses efficient, well-sequenced steps without thrash, redundancy, or destructive actions.
criteria.method: Read the experiment result's replay D2 mean for the selected arm and inspect the score evidence.
criteria.driftMarkers: Selected-arm D2 falls despite outcome gains, indicating the experiment is rewarding process debt.

criteria.title: Divergence value
criteria.model: Where the selected continuation departs from the historical continuation, the departure helps rather than harms the task.
criteria.method: Read the experiment result's replay D3 mean for the selected arm and the divergence signal summary.
criteria.driftMarkers: Selected-arm D3 is low or unknown, especially when the experiment still chooses a winner.
